decision_rule: HIP build qualification only: pinned v10 and diagnostic patch; exact generated modes source/header hashes; full executable with rollback/verify-batch/fault markers; GGML_HIP ON and gfx90a CMake binding; hashed libggml-hip with compiled HIP registration and gfx90a image marker; all llama/ggml linkage local to this build. No native model execution, rollback, residency or performance verdict. Stop on validated full receipt; futility on source mismatch, build/linkage failure, STOP or deadline. R2 additionally requires the Clang enum-constexpr compatibility flag and a compiled IQK implementation symbol; smoke must reproduce the unsuppressed IQK error then pass the identical source with the flag. R3 requires exact defined text exports iqk_mul_mat and ggml_iqk_try_mul_mat from the hash-bound CPU library, and ggml_backend_cuda_reg from the hash-bound HIP library; undefined imports and substring matches do not qualify.
